newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai mobile telephone users double in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai mobile telephone users double in 1996.

text.p: As of Thursday, Shanghai added 160,000 new mobile telephones in 1996, taking the total in the city to 324,000, ranking first of major cities in China, the Liberation Daily reported on Friday.
The city has a total capacity of 410,000 mobile phones and users can call most places in China and many destinations overseas, it said.
The city's long-distance telephone bureau on Thursday announced a cut of 500 yuan in the price of one of its most popular mobile telephone models, the newspaper added but gave no more details.
